summary_1line: Bhishma, lying on his bed of arrows, refuses treatment; Arjuna shoots an arrow into the earth to produce a divine stream of water for him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma lies upon a bed of arrows while Arjuna shoots a blazing arrow into the earth, from which a cool jet of water rises to his lips.
Both Pandava and Kaurava warriors lay down their weapons and gather together reverently around Bhishma resting on the arrow-bed.
Thousands of maidens scatter sandalwood powder and flowers over Bhishma as crowds and kings assemble around the wounded grandsire.
